Richard, saw Ever.Ag just unveiled Everett and already expanded it across livestock and animal protein.

A multi-segment rollout throws off expansion and intent signals, but most revops teams cannot route them to action fast enough before they go cold. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized outreach autonomously, 3-5x more meetings per rep without new headcount.

I built a signal play for Ever.Ag off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Richard, quick follow-up for Ever.Ag.

The gap between a buying signal firing and a rep acting on it is usually where measurable lift hides, and it is hard to see from inside the funnel. Tightening that latency is one of the fastest ways to move reply rates.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Richard, last bit of proof for Ever.Ag.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Ever.Ag reply rate likely compares to other agtech platforms. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
